title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program: Installment Rule for the First Installment
content:
The installment rule of a Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program installment arrangement sets how the first installment is taken from the open balance and the installment count. The enrollment's final billed month is the billing month of its latest tuition charge.

- **When the final billed month carries a late payment fee:** that late payment fee is taken in full in the first installment, together with an equal share of the rest of the open balance (the open balance less that fee, divided by the installment count).
- **When that month carries no late payment fee and the open balance is less than 50.00:** the larger of 25.00 and an equal share of the open balance (the open balance divided by the installment count) is taken.
- **Otherwise:** an equal share of the open balance is taken.

## Worked cases (hypothetical figures)

| Open balance | Late payment fee on the final billed month | Installment count | First installment |
|---|---|---|---|
| 341.00 | 13.00 | 4 | 13.00 plus a quarter of 328.00, which is 95.00 |
| 341.00 | none | 4 | a quarter of 341.00, which is 85.25 |
| 38.00 | none | 2 | the larger of 25.00 and 19.00, which is 25.00 |
| 38.00 | none | 1 | 38.00 |
| 50.00 | none | 4 | an equal share, 12.50 |
